title: Pregnant Blend 3-Mix Solo #02 (가로 띠·물결)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Lebanese woman, an adult, in her late 20s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy on top of an already immense frame. An immense mass of soft heavy fat already sits on her middle in heavy rounded folds — and rising from the top of that mass, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects even further forward, its taut round surface distinct from the looser folds beneath it, no waist at all anywhere. A gigantic bust resting above the belly, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, radiant glowing bridal makeup, dramatic long lashes, a soft rose lip, warm fair skin, soft rose-gold hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real pores, real living eyes, 8 a mix of hoops, studs and drops piercings set with sapphires in rose-gold-toned metal, wearing seven to ten pieces, heavily stacked of mixed-metal an anklet. Full body painted in 3 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 horizontal bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 41% of the way down her figure from the top and about 76% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it is painted in Hungarian Kalocsa folk painted motif (a deep black ground with bright red, pink and gold folk-art florals), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with folk-art floral motifs filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Russian Palekh miniature lacquer (a deep black ground with fine gold linework and firebirds), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with jewel-toned scenework filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything below the last transition zone: it is painted in Klimt-inspired organic mosaic (an organic mosaic of small irregular tesserae with gold-leaf borders), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with organic curved mosaic filling the space between bands. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: standing at a slight three-quarter angle, one hand resting on her own hip and the other beneath her belly's curve, composed radiant expression, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
